entries.title: Psalms 13:1
segments: To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. How long will You forget me, O LORD? Forever? How long will You hide Your face from me?

entries.title: Psalms 13:2
segments: How long shall I take counsel in my heart [having] sorrow in my heart daily? How long shall my enemy be lifted up over me?

entries.title: Psalms 13:3
segments: Look! Answer me, O LORD my God; enlighten my eyes, lest I sleep the [sleep of] death,

entries.title: Psalms 13:4
segments: lest my enemy say, I have overcome him, and my foes rejoice when I am shaken.

entries.title: Psalms 13:5
segments: But I have trusted in Your mercy; my heart shall rejoice in Your salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 13:6
segments: I will sing to the LORD, because He has rewarded me.
